prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: ON state of the exact same transparent event festoon bulb for a pixel-aligned UI crossfade.
Edit target: The supplied OFF-state bulb PNG. Preserve the existing 1024x1536 portrait canvas, bulb silhouette, socket, mounting eyelet, glass contour, position, size, framing, camera and all product details exactly. Do not redraw or move the bulb. The socket remains identical and unlit.
Primary request: Change only the fine tungsten filament from OFF to ON. Give that existing filament a warm amber 2700K incandescent emission, with a small physically plausible warm light in the glass volume and a subtle soft exterior glow immediately around the glass. The source light must clearly come from the filament. Keep the clear glass and existing photographic reflections legible.
Scene/backdrop: Preserve real transparency. All empty background and the hole in the socket mounting eyelet remain transparent.
Materials/textures: Keep the exact same matte dark charcoal/oxblood weatherproof socket, clear glass, support wires and filament geometry.
Constraints: Exact same geometry and registration as the input for smooth crossfade. Same dimensions. No color shift on the socket, no added wire, no new objects, no ground or background, no text or logo.
Avoid: oversized halo, neon, orange background, white opaque background, cartoon glow, altered silhouette, shifted product, cropped product or extra bulb.
